name: toopo
description: Copy utility functions into your project, each verified against a public, executable contract. Not a dependency: the source lands in your repository and it is yours.
author: Mathis Perron <hello@toopo.dev>

scripts.registry: tsc -p packages/registry/tsconfig.json && node run-vitest.ts run --config packages/registry/vitest.config.ts
scripts.validation: tsc -p packages/validation/tsconfig.json && node run-vitest.ts run --config packages/validation/vitest.config.ts
scripts.cli: tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && node run-vitest.ts run --config packages/cli/vitest.config.ts
scripts.site: tsc -p packages/site/tsconfig.json && node run-vitest.ts run --config packages/site/vitest.config.ts
scripts.packaging: tsc -p packaging/tsconfig.json && node run-vitest.ts run --config packaging/vitest.config.ts
